Emergency Assistance for Tourists in Korea

If you are currently traveling in South Korea and require immediate interpretation or emergency assistance, please contact the official 24-hour government helplines:

  • Korea Travel Helpline 1330: Call 1330 (From overseas: +82-2-1330) — 24/7 free multilingual support (English, Japanese, Chinese, Russian, Vietnamese, Thai, Malay).
  • Police: 112
  • Fire & Medical Emergency: 119
